findings.text: `_client_cache_root` is a fifth cache cascade (`RECKON_CLIENT_CACHE` → `XDG_CACHE_HOME` → `~/.cache/reckon/client`) of the same shape §13 consolidates, but the plan's census counts "four cache cascades" and §13's kind set (velocity, clones, pick, run-time-profile) omits it, so §13's own done-when — "`grep -rn 'XDG_CACHE_HOME' reckon/` reports the cascade in exactly one function" — is unsatisfiable as written and a fifth copy survives the consolidation it exists to perform

findings.reason: the author would express `velocity.git` as a raising wrapper over the core runner (mirroring the `routing._git` treatment) and drop a runner, or state the contract difference that forbids it.
findings.text: §13 gives the core layer a new public process-returning git runner "beside" `velocity.git` and leaves `velocity.git`'s shape unchanged, without stating why `velocity.git` cannot be the raising wrapper over the one runner the way §13 rewrites `routing._git` (`reckon/crew/routing.py:473`) as a `CrewError` wrapper over it, so the same library keeps two process-invoking runners side by side and the diff shrinks nothing

rubric_items.duplicate_owner: a finding — §13 adds a second process-returning git runner to `reckon/velocity.py` beside the existing `velocity.git` (reckon/velocity.py:147) and does not express `velocity.git` over it, though it applies that exact raising-wrapper pattern to `routing._git`.
rubric_items.interface_budget: pass — public_definitions 1476, cli_options 317, mcp_views 33, refusal_families 23; §12 states a net zero (it adds the sources reader and retires the public `revised_python`) and §13 states a growth of two, naming the retired resolvers as private, so neither section adds to a family without accounting for what it retires.
rubric_items.reuse_search: a finding — the plan searched and does cite the mechanisms it extends (`velocity.git`, `read_blobs`, `read_trees`, `routing._git`, and the four cache cascades), but its cascade census misses `reckon/serve.py:467 _client_cache_root`, a fifth copy of the same env → `XDG_CACHE_HOME` → `~/.cache/reckon/<leaf>` shape.
rubric_items.thin_wrapper: pass — the plan keeps `routing._git` only as a stated error-domain wrapper that will call the core runner (`reckon/crew/routing.py:473`), and justifies the new public reader by its two consumers rather than adding a bare pass-through.
